summary: Globe Life Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 1.01 to disclose entry into a Third Amended and Restated Credit Agreement and an Amended and Restated Term Loan Agreement. These are routine debt facility refinancings that change the administrative agent from Bank of America to Wells Fargo, extend the maturity date to June 2031, and amend existing credit facilities. No acquisition, divestiture, or other special situation is involved; the filing simply updates credit terms with no equity issuance, buyback, or strategic event. This is an ordinary financing activity with no deal terms or special-situation catalysts.
